description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Reef Worm, adding {U}.
When Reef Worm dies, it and Enduring Renewal triggers.
Resolve the Reef Worm trigger, creating a 3/3 Fish creature token.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Reef Worm from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Fish, adding {1}.
When the Fish dies, it triggers, creating a 6/6 Whale creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Whale, adding {1}.
When the Whale dies, it triggers, creating a 9/9 Kraken creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Kraken, adding {1}.
Cast Reef Worm by paying {3}{U}.
Repeat.
